description: The Risk & Opportunity Matrix by Cilver is a comprehensive Power BI custom visual designed to transform how organizations monitor and report on their risk landscapes. By bridging the gap between static data and dynamic visualization, it enables risk managers to view both downside risks and upside opportunities in a single, unified interface. ▸Value Proposition While traditional risk matrices offer a static snapshot, this visual introduces dynamic mitigation tracking. It allows users to quantify the ROI of risk management by comparing pre-mitigation and post-mitigation states. Integrated trajectory animations provide a temporal view of risk movement, enabling teams to identify emerging trends and validate the effectiveness of their strategic responses. ▸Core Capabilities • Dual-State Comparison: Directly visualize the shift in Likelihood and Impact following mitigation efforts. • Temporal Trajectories: Animate risk progression across reporting periods to identify historical trends and future volatility. • Multi-View Heatmaps: Toggle between severity clusters, post-mitigation outcomes, and value-change tracking within a single interface. • Integrated KPI Strip: Real-time visibility into high-level metrics, including Average Risk Score, Total Exposure, and % Improved vs. % Critical. • Interactive Contextual Tooltips: Access granular data on…
